title: Video artifacts — a small YAML file of slides and narration, played live with a voiceover
description: A video is an independent artifact: one NN_<slug>.video.yaml file of slides, the items on them, narration beats and one-line actions, about 7 KB for three minutes. Rust checks it, resolves its components from the project's libraries and computes every time; a framework-free TypeScript player draws it live in the browser with the Web Animations API on a 12 x 6 grid. The voice is Kokoro-82M, run by a separate helper, agentks-voice, with a pronunciation list; clips live in ~/.agentks/audio/ and are never committed. No MP4 or any rendered video file. Frames, icons, charts, layouts, presets and slide templates come from library components. Design in brainstorm/01_video-artifact-engine/.
author: claude
